title: It’s a great app but
body: Widget not working. Viewable widget but tapping on the widget nothing happens which makes it less convenient then it is as I then need to swipe to find the actual app to open to use it.
author: TheSinglishMan

title: App is buggy on iOS 18
body: Works mostly well but for having paid a premium subscription, I expect the statistics views to also work instead of crashing the app.
author: Kapilan Naidu

title: Scam developer
body: This developer had an app which is exactly the same  which they abandoned because the users called them out for scamming them out of their subscriptions. Now they started this app with a different name to scam more people. Subscribe at your own risk.
author: llAnonymousllReviewer||

title: Reminder at 8am only?
body:
Edit: Not sure if it’s the free version only but the only reminder that can be set is for 8am. Not very useful for evening habits. 
The notification for a habit set to evening appears in the morning “did you remember to…”  Changing the frequency to another time of day e.g. morning would be weird which is the response suggested by the developer. You should be able to set the time at which you want the notification for a habit to appear but you cannot.
author: Daveyah

title: 专业版价格太贵
body: 免费版功能太少。而专业版价格贵的离谱。一个简单的日常提醒，价格竟超过1Password！
author: ydw5168

title: Great reminder app
body: So far this is the best reminder app for me. Together with apple watch, I can easily update my progress. It would be great if we can customize the quick add and have lower price for in-app purchase.
